papers.what_it_is: A 59-page Interviewbit introductory cheat sheet on Python syntax, built-in types, control flow, data structures, standard modules and IPython magic commands.
papers.why_not: The document is a general-purpose Python language tutorial. It states no claim about quantum machine learning, quantum computing, classical machine learning, finance or fraud, or statistical evaluation method. It reports no measurement, theorem or experiment. Its only link to machine learning is the name of a link in the closing list (Machine Learning Interview Questions), which has no content in the document.
